description: Dataset from Denmark for Modeling a Highly Renewable Power System is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors xuw. This is a completed database of Danish electrical transmission system for modeling an electrical system with high penetration of renewable energy. Coverage: national (DK); the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
